nodes.name: M oxides/hydroxides nanorod preparation
nodes.procedure: M-containing oxides/hydroxides nanorods were first prepared (Fig. S6–S15, ESI†)
nodes.source_text: M-containing oxides/hydroxides nanorods were first prepared (Fig. S6–S15, ESI†)

nodes.name: Polydopamine coating, carbonization, and acid etching
nodes.procedure: M-containing oxides/hydroxides nanorods were coated with polydopamine derived from dopamine. Thermal treatment at 800 °C in argon was conducted to convert polydopamine to nitrogen-doped carbon with M-containing species supported thereon. Sufficient acid etching under varied conditions formed uniformly dispersed single atom M₁ or MₓOᵧ nanoclusters on nitrogen-doped carbon support (M₁/NC or MₓOᵧ/NC)

nodes.name: Ru impregnation and reduction
nodes.procedure: Ru precursors were further impregnated onto the M1/NC or the MxOy/NC. At last, the MxOy–Run/NC catalyst and the M1–Run/NC catalyst were acquired individually through hydrogen reduction at 300 °C (Fig. 2 and Fig. S37–S41, ESI†)
